headlines.title: The 10-Year Treasury Yields 4.91%. These 4 Dividend Stocks Pay More
headlines.summary: The 10-year Treasury now hands you a nearly 5% yield with zero credit risk, so any dividend stock asking you to take on more complexity had better earn it. These four names do, and they come with something a government bond can never offer.

headlines.title: MPC Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Refining Margins
headlines.summary: Marathon Petroleum's Q3 earnings surge on stronger refining margins, while renewable diesel turns profitable and the company expands its share buyback plans.

news.summary: Marathon Petroleum reported a Q3 earnings beat on strong refining margins and expanded its share buyback plans. It agreed to sell its St. Paul Park and Mandan refineries and related marketing business to CVR Energy for $4.2 billion. On November 4 the stock fell 10% in a broader oil-stock selloff that headlines attributed to Democrats winning Senate control.
drivers: Q3 earnings beat on strong refining margins
$4.2B refinery and marketing asset sale to CVR Energy
Expanded share buyback plans
10% drop in oil-stock selloff after Senate result

headlines.title: Tesla Sinks 12%, SpaceX Down 9% as Midterm Sweep Puts Merger on “A Much Tougher Regulatory Roadmap”
headlines.summary: [IMAGE CREDIT: NASA/Aubrey Gemignani via Canva] Key TakeawaysTesla shares fell 12% today, and SpaceX fell too, after Democrats swept Congress and Texas and raised doubts about a SpaceX-Tesla merger. A slower merger takes away part of the case Tesla’s bulls have made since October.

news.summary: SpaceX (SPCX) shares fell about 9% on November 5, 2026, after Democrats swept Congress and Texas, which raised doubts about a SpaceX-Tesla merger and its regulatory path. Separately, headlines reported growing backlash over a planned 6-gigawatt Arizona AI data center. Analysts remained divided, with China Renaissance initiating coverage at Buy with a $194.20 target and another firm raising its fair value estimate to $257.11.
drivers: Democratic midterm sweep and merger regulatory doubts
Backlash over 6-gigawatt Arizona AI data center
Weakness in chip stocks
Mixed analyst views, including a Buy initiation and raised fair value
